summary: Set an apt hold on the curl package (7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19) on node1 using `apt-mark hold curl`, confirmed via a simulated `apt-get upgrade -s` that curl is excluded from update candidates even though other packages would be upgraded, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id/curl state, rebooted node1 with `systemctl reboot`, polled until it came back with a new boot_id, and reverified curl's package/hold state and version were unchanged post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Ubuntu 16.04 Xenial) and curl package baseline (7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19, no prior holds)
Ran `sudo apt-mark hold curl` and confirmed via `apt-mark showhold` and `dpkg --get-selections curl`
Ran `apt-get update` then simulated `apt-get upgrade -s`, confirming many packages would update but curl is absent from the change list
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime/curl state baseline for the restart protocol
Triggered `systemctl reboot` on node1 via a backgrounded/delayed command so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until SSH was reachable again
Verified boot_id changed (35c87ec9... -> 8b34a1ec...) and fresh `uptime -s` timestamp, proving an actual restart
Reverified post-restart that curl package version, hold status, and functionality (curl --version) are unchanged

evidence.requirement: curl held at current version so system update won't upgrade it
evidence.summary: Baseline showed curl 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 with no hold; `apt-mark hold curl` applied and confirmed via showhold/dpkg selections; simulated apt-get upgrade lists many packages to update but curl is not among them, proving the hold is effective.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 35c87ec9-1707-4fb3-ab1d-f264d3618caa and curl package/hold state prior to reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: `systemctl reboot` issued via backgrounded delayed command; tool call returned successfully (reboot scheduled, pid=2743) before the node went down.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: proof node actually went down and came back with changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection refused observed during the reboot window, then a new boot_id (8b34a1ec-2854-4280-9f12-91675720ee2b) was returned once the node came back, differing from the pre-restart boot_id.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: post-restart recovery/state verification
evidence.summary: Post-reboot check shows fresh uptime (2026-09-29 11:02:18), curl still installed at 7.47.0-1ubuntu2.19 with hold status intact, and curl functioning normally.
